title: Hirayasumi Anime Announces 5 More Cast Members
content: The staff for the television anime of Keigo Shinzō 's Hirayasumi manga (a co-production with Shogakukan-Shueisha Productions Co., Ltd and Production +h. ) announced five more cast members on Tuesday.
author: ANN

title: 'Hirayasumi' Announces Additional Cast
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Keigo Shinzou 's Hirayasumi manga announced five additional cast members on Tuesday. The anime series will premiere on NHK-G in January 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Attack on Titan Musical Starts World Tour in Singapore Next April
content: Attack on Titan : The Musical , the stage musical based on Hajime Isayama 's Attack on Titan manga, announced on Tuesday that the musical will go on a world tour that will begin with a run at the Sands Theatre, Marina Bay Sands in Singapore from April 15 to May 2, 2027.
author: ANN

title: Voice Actress Manaka Iwami Announces Marriage
content: Voice actress Manaka Iwami announced her marriage to a man outside of the industry and the birth of her first child on her official radio program on Tuesday. "It's been a while, everyone. This is Manaka Iwami.

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Film's New Video Unveils Kajadan Pirates' Cast
content: TOHO animation began streaming a character trailer for The Apothecary Diaries : The Late Lady's Treasure ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto: Bо̄hi no Hihо̄ ), the upcoming anime film based on Hyuganatsu and Touko Shino 's The Apothecary Diaries ( Kusuriya no Hitorigoto ) light novel series, on Tuesday.

title: Fall’s Darkest Romance Anime Confirms New Live-Action Series for 2027
content: Firefly Wedding is one of the biggest anime series of the Fall 2026 anime season. As the series continues to gain popularity thanks to its unique storytelling and gorgeous visuals, Comic Natalie confirms the series is getting its very own live-action series.
author: ComicBook

title: Madoka Magica’s Big Film Trilogy Is Going to Be Easier to Watch Than Ever
content: After more than 12 years, the film trilogy of Puella Magi Madoka Magica will officially be streaming on Netflix. The films were originally released in 2012 and 2013, and now the official X handle of Netflix Anime has confirmed the platform will be adding these movies to its library next year.
author: ComicBook

title: The Remarried Empress to Make Anime Debut With Crunchyroll in 2027 – Watch First Look Trailer
content: The Remarried Empress is finally getting an anime adaptation after its controversial light novel and manhwa. The webtoon industry is on the rise thanks to several anime adaptations.
